title: 2026 Honda CR-V EX-L vs. 2026 Mazda CX-5 Premium Plus Comparison Test
summary: The CX-5 and CR-V are both longtime Car and Driver favorites, but with the Mazda fully redesigned for 2026, which one comes out on top?
whatHappening: Car and Driver is pitting the 2026 Honda CR-V EX-L against the fully redesigned 2026 Mazda CX-5 Premium Plus to determine which compact crossover SUV reigns supreme. Both vehicles are established favorites at the publication, but Mazda's ground-up redesign reshuffles the competitive landscape.
whoInvolved: Honda and Mazda, two major Japanese automakers, are competing in the highly competitive compact crossover segment. Both companies have built strong reputations for reliability and driving dynamics, with their CR-V and CX-5 models consistently ranking among the segment's best-sellers.
whyMatters: Compact crossovers are the fastest-growing segment in the U.S. auto market, making this comparison critical for millions of shoppers deciding between two top contenders. The outcome could influence purchase decisions worth tens of billions in combined sales, as these vehicles represent some of the most popular models on American roads.
moreContext: The Honda CR-V has dominated its class for decades, known for spacious interiors and reliability. Mazda has spent years positioning the CX-5 as a more engaging, upscale alternative that prioritizes driving dynamics and design refinement. The 2026 CX-5 redesign marks a significant refresh, introducing new styling, updated technology, and potentially improved performance that could challenge the CR-V's market dominance. This comparison test arrives at a pivotal moment when shoppers can evaluate whether Mazda's redesign efforts successfully close the gap or establish a new benchmark in the segment.

title: View Photos of the 2027 Mercedes-Benz C-Class EV
summary: See the interior and exterior of the 2027 Mercedes-Benz C-class EV from every angle.
whatHappening: Mercedes-Benz is unveiling the 2027 C-Class EV with detailed photos showing both interior and exterior designs. The automaker is giving consumers a comprehensive first look at the electric version of its popular compact luxury sedan from multiple angles.
whoInvolved: Mercedes-Benz, the German luxury automaker, is behind this reveal. The company is one of the world's largest premium vehicle manufacturers and a major player in the global shift toward electrification.
whyMatters: This launch signals Mercedes-Benz's commitment to electrifying its core lineup, including mass-market luxury models. The 2027 C-Class EV could significantly influence the competitive landscape in the premium EV segment as traditional luxury brands compete with Tesla and newer EV manufacturers.
moreContext: Mercedes-Benz has aggressively pushed toward electrification, with plans to transition its entire lineup to electric vehicles by 2030 in developed markets. The C-Class is the automaker's best-selling model globally, making its EV variant crucial to the company's decarbonization strategy. This move comes as legacy automakers race to match Tesla's market dominance and meet tightening European emissions regulations. The 2027 timeline indicates the vehicle will arrive during a critical period when EV adoption is expected to accelerate significantly in luxury segments.

title: 2027 Mercedes-Benz C-Class EV Drive: EQ Who?
summary: The brand's latest electric sedan is way easier to like than its earlier efforts.
whatHappening: Mercedes-Benz is unveiling its 2027 C-Class EV, an electric sedan that marks a significant improvement over the brand's previous electric vehicle attempts. The new model is generating positive reception for its design and usability compared to earlier EQ offerings.
whoInvolved: Mercedes-Benz, the German luxury automaker, is pushing deeper into the electric vehicle market with this redesigned C-Class sedan. The company has been developing its EQ sub-brand for electric vehicles over the past several years.
whyMatters: This represents a critical moment for Mercedes' EV transition, as previous electric models faced criticism that could have damaged the brand's luxury reputation. A more compelling C-Class EV could accelerate adoption among luxury buyers and strengthen Mercedes' competitive position against Tesla and other EV manufacturers.
moreContext: Mercedes launched its EQ brand in 2016 but faced mixed reviews on early models that struggled with design appeal and user experience compared to the company's traditional combustion engine vehicles. The 2027 C-Class EV appears to address these shortcomings with improved aesthetics and functionality. The timing matters as luxury automakers face increasing pressure to electrify their core lineups to meet regulatory requirements and changing consumer preferences. Car and Driver's positive assessment suggests Mercedes may finally be cracking the code on making electric luxury sedans that satisfy both enthusiasts and practical buyers.

title: Land Rover Discontinues the Discovery Sport After 11 Years
summary: The Discovery Sport will end production in December, with 2026 becoming the compact SUV's final model year.
whatHappening: Land Rover is discontinuing the Discovery Sport, its compact SUV that has been in production for 11 years. Production will end in December, with 2026 being the final model year.
whoInvolved: Land Rover, the British luxury automaker owned by Jaguar Land Rover (a subsidiary of Tata Motors), is making this decision. The Discovery Sport has been a key model in their lineup since its 2014 debut.
whyMatters: The discontinuation reflects shifting market demands toward electric vehicles and larger SUVs, forcing traditional automakers to streamline their lineups. For buyers, this signals fewer options in the compact luxury SUV segment and may drive demand toward remaining competitors or push consumers toward Land Rover's other models.
moreContext: The Discovery Sport launched in 2014 as a replacement for the Freelander, becoming one of Land Rover's best-selling models globally. The move aligns with parent company Jaguar Land Rover's broader electrification strategy, as the company transitions toward battery-powered vehicles. This discontinuation comes as the automotive industry faces pressure to reduce internal combustion engine offerings. Land Rover continues to offer the larger Discovery and the Range Rover Sport, which may cannibalize some Discovery Sport sales.

title: Honda Could Target Subaru Outback Buyers with a Lifted Accord SUV
summary: Honda hopes that in the wake of the Outback's transformation into a more traditional SUV, buyers will flock to a reimagination of the Accord Crosstour.
whatHappening: Honda is considering reviving the Accord Crosstour as a lifted SUV to compete in the segment Subaru's Outback once dominated. The automaker sees an opportunity to capture buyers who are dissatisfied with the Outback's shift toward a more traditional SUV design.
whoInvolved: Honda, the Japanese automaker known for sedans and crossovers, is looking to capitalize on Subaru's strategic pivot. Subaru, maker of the Outback wagon-SUV hybrid, recently redesigned the model as a more conventional SUV, potentially alienating buyers who preferred its car-based platform.
whyMatters: A new Accord Crosstour could fill a niche gap for buyers seeking a vehicle with car-like handling and efficiency but with added ground clearance and cargo space. This move could help Honda attract Outback customers and strengthen its position in the crossover segment, which continues to grow.
moreContext: The original Accord Crosstour, produced from 2010 to 2015, was Honda's attempt at a lifted wagon but faced lukewarm sales due to uncertain positioning. Subaru's Outback has traditionally appealed to buyers wanting practicality without committing to a fully rugged SUV. The crossover market has exploded in recent years, with manufacturers increasingly creating variations to capture different buyer preferences. If Honda moves forward, it would represent a bet that there's still demand for car-based, efficiency-focused alternatives to traditional SUVs.

title: View Photos of the 2001 Qvale Mangusta
summary: See the interior and exterior of the 2001 Qvale Mangusta from every angle.
whatHappening: Car and Driver is showcasing a comprehensive photo gallery of the 2001 Qvale Mangusta, featuring detailed views of both the car's interior and exterior from multiple angles.
whoInvolved: Qvale Automotive Group, a San Diego-based manufacturer, produced the Mangusta as an Italian-designed, American-built sports car. Car and Driver, a leading automotive publication, is providing visual documentation of the vehicle.
whyMatters: The Qvale Mangusta represents a rare attempt at domestic supercar production during the early 2000s, offering insight into an ambitious but ultimately short-lived American sports car project. Visual walkarounds help enthusiasts and collectors understand the car's design details and engineering during a niche era of automotive manufacturing.
moreContext: The Qvale Mangusta was designed by Italian coachbuilder Qvale with a mid-mounted engine and carbon-fiber body, marking one of few American-made supercars of its generation. Only 12 examples were built before the company ceased operations in 2003, making it an obscure collectible. The car featured a 5.7-liter V8 engine and a sleek, aggressive design that drew influence from Italian sports car traditions. Its rarity and distinctive styling have made it a curiosity piece in automotive history.

title: AEV's Second Ford Super Duty Package Is Extreme Off-Road Lite
summary: Following the FXL revealed earlier this year, the FX370 makes do with 37-inch tires instead of 40s.
whatHappening: AEV has launched the FX370, its second extreme off-road Ford Super Duty package following the FXL introduced earlier this year. The new variant uses 37-inch tires instead of the FXL's 40-inch tires, offering a more accessible performance tier.
whoInvolved: AEV (American Expedition Vehicles) is a specialized manufacturer known for building high-performance off-road vehicle packages and upgrades. Ford Super Duty is the company's heavy-duty truck line targeting commercial and personal use.
whyMatters: The FX370 expands AEV's off-road truck portfolio to capture buyers seeking extreme capability without the maximum investment of the 40-inch tire setup. This tiered approach allows AEV to reach a broader market segment while maintaining premium positioning in the off-road truck segment.
moreContext: AEV has built a reputation for engineering rugged, expedition-ready truck packages that appeal to serious off-road enthusiasts and overlanding communities. The FXL's debut earlier this year marked AEV's aggressive push into the Ford Super Duty market. The 37-inch tire size represents a middle ground between standard Super Duty setups and extreme off-road builds, offering improved ground clearance and terrain capability while maintaining better highway manners and fuel efficiency than larger tires. This multi-tier strategy reflects growing consumer demand for customizable off-road vehicles.

title: Test: 2001 Qvale Mangusta Is a Head-Turner and a Head-Scratcher
summary: Owners will have some explaining to do.
whatHappening: Car and Driver is testing the 2001 Qvale Mangusta, a rare Italian-American sports car that turns heads but leaves owners scrambling for explanations. The vehicle is visually striking yet mechanically puzzling.
whoInvolved: Qvale Automobili, an Italian company, partnered with American engineering to produce the Mangusta. Car and Driver, a leading automotive publication, conducted the evaluation.
whyMatters: The Mangusta represents an unusual chapter in sports car history—a low-volume exotic that struggled to find its identity. Understanding vehicles like this reveals how ambitious automotive startups often fail to deliver on their promises despite appealing designs.
moreContext: The Qvale Mangusta was produced from 1998 to 2002 with extremely limited numbers, making it a rare curiosity today. The car attempted to blend Italian sports car aesthetics with American V8 power and practicality, but faced significant quality and reliability issues. Its obscurity means most enthusiasts have never heard of it, let alone seen one. The model exemplifies the risks of small independent manufacturers trying to compete against established luxury and performance brands.

title: Obsessively Maintained 1990 Ferrari Testarossa For Sale on BaT
summary: While another Testarossa with lower miles than this car's 3700 may exist, it's hard to imagine there's one that has been better cared for.
whatHappening: A pristine 1990 Ferrari Testarossa with only 3,700 miles is being offered for sale on Bring a Trailer (BaT), an online auction platform for collectible vehicles. The car has been obsessively maintained throughout its ownership history, setting it apart from other examples of the same model.
whoInvolved: Car and Driver is reporting on the sale, while Bring a Trailer (BaT) is the auction platform facilitating the transaction. BaT has become a major marketplace for high-end collector cars and enthusiasts seeking rare, well-documented vehicles.
whyMatters: Extremely low-mileage, meticulously maintained supercars command premium prices in the collector car market and represent investments for wealthy enthusiasts. The condition of this particular Testarossa—likely better preserved than competing examples—could set valuation benchmarks for 1990 models and influence future asking prices.
moreContext: The Ferrari Testarossa, produced from 1984 to 1996, is one of the most iconic supercars of the 1980s and early 1990s, known for its distinctive side strakes and 12-cylinder engine. Ultra-low-mileage, garage-kept examples are highly sought after by collectors because most Testarossas from this era have been driven substantially. The condition of a vehicle becomes exponentially more valuable as mileage decreases, with sub-5,000-mile examples commanding significant premiums over higher-mileage counterparts.

title: The Best Odds: 2000-01 Qvale Mangusta
summary: The cars I recall most fondly were neither the prettiest nor the quickest. Certainly not the most expensive. They were machines that emerged willfully peculiar and intractably idiosyncratic.
whatHappening: Car and Driver is reflecting on the 2000-01 Qvale Mangusta, celebrating it as a memorable automotive oddity rather than a conventional performance machine. The piece emphasizes how certain cars stand out not for being the fastest or most beautiful, but for their willfully peculiar and idiosyncratic character.
whoInvolved: Qvale Automobiles, a niche Italian-American sports car manufacturer, produced the Mangusta during the early 2000s. The company was known for creating small-batch, unconventional vehicles that prioritized distinctive character over mainstream appeal.
whyMatters: This perspective shift—valuing quirky authenticity over raw performance metrics—reflects a growing automotive enthusiasm for uniqueness and personality in an era increasingly dominated by mass-produced standardization. Such vehicles often become collector's items and cultural touchstones, influencing how enthusiasts evaluate automotive merit beyond horsepower and aesthetics.
moreContext: The Qvale Mangusta emerged during a period when independent sports car manufacturers competed fiercely against established brands by offering bold, unconventional designs. Rather than chasing top speed records or luxury price points, the Mangusta carved out identity through its distinctive styling and rare availability. This era of automotive history celebrated mechanical personality and driving experience, qualities that have experienced renewed appreciation among modern collectors and enthusiasts seeking alternatives to cookie-cutter modern vehicles.

title: 2001 Comparison Test: Audi A4, BMW 325i, Lexus IS300, M-B C240, Saab 9-3, Volvo S60
summary: From the archive: Six sports sedans that are guaranteed to dial up your thermostat.
whatHappening: Car and Driver is revisiting a classic 2001 comparison test of six premium sports sedans: the Audi A4, BMW 325i, Lexus IS300, Mercedes-Benz C240, Saab 9-3, and Volvo S60. The test evaluates how these vehicles stack up against each other in performance, handling, and overall driving dynamics.
whoInvolved: Car and Driver, a leading automotive publication, conducted the original test comparing six major manufacturers' mid-size sedan offerings. The brands represent different automotive philosophies: German engineering (Audi, BMW, Mercedes), Japanese reliability (Lexus), and Swedish design (Saab, Volvo).
whyMatters: This archival comparison provides historical perspective on how the premium sedan segment has evolved over two decades. It documents the performance benchmarks and design priorities that defined the early 2000s luxury market, offering insights into which brands' approaches have endured or changed. Understanding these baseline evaluations helps readers appreciate how modern successors have advanced in technology and capability.
moreContext: The early 2000s represented a pivotal era for premium compact sedans, with manufacturers competing fiercely to capture younger, performance-minded buyers. The IS300 marked Lexus's entry into the sports sedan category with a naturally-aspirated inline-six engine, challenging established German competitors. This period preceded the rise of turbocharged engines and advanced driver-assistance systems that would dominate the segment by the 2010s. The comparison reflects a time when manual transmissions were still common in performance sedans and driving engagement was a primary marketing differentiator.

title: Andretti's Formula E Cars Get a Japanese Tuner Makeover for Tokyo
summary: Widebody specialist Liberty Walk is lending a silver-and-blue livery to this month's midnight racers, as Formula E races on the streets of Tokyo.
whatHappening: Andretti's Formula E team is partnering with Japanese widebody specialist Liberty Walk to create custom silver-and-blue liveries for their cars competing in this month's Formula E race on the streets of Tokyo. The collaboration brings street car tuning culture into the world of electric motorsports.
whoInvolved: Andretti is a major American motorsports team with a storied history across multiple racing series. Liberty Walk is a renowned Japanese automotive customization shop famous for creating aggressive widebody kits and distinctive visual modifications for high-performance vehicles.
whyMatters: The partnership represents a unique crossover between elite motorsports and automotive customization culture, potentially broadening Formula E's appeal to car enthusiast audiences. It also highlights how motorsports teams are leveraging local partnerships to build brand presence in key international markets like Japan.
moreContext: Formula E has been expanding its global footprint with races in major cities, with Tokyo being a significant market for automotive brands. Liberty Walk's involvement reflects Japan's deep car culture and tuning heritage, which influences global automotive aesthetics. This type of livery partnership has become increasingly common in motorsports as teams seek sponsorship and marketing differentiation. The midnight racing aspect suggests these could be special exhibition or night race events, which have gained popularity in urban racing venues.

title: 3700-Mile 2008 Audi S4 Avant on Bring a Trailer
summary: With a V-8 and a manual transmission, this wagon is one rare machine.
whatHappening: A pristine 2008 Audi S4 Avant with only 3,700 miles on the odometer is being auctioned on Bring a Trailer. The wagon is equipped with a V-8 engine and manual transmission—a increasingly rare combination in the modern automotive market.
whoInvolved: Bring a Trailer is an online auction platform specializing in collector and enthusiast vehicles. Audi, the German luxury automaker, produced the S4 Avant as a high-performance wagon variant during the mid-2000s.
whyMatters: Manual transmissions have become nearly extinct in performance vehicles, making this example particularly valuable to driving enthusiasts. Ultra-low mileage collector cars like this one often command premium prices as preserved examples of automotive history.
moreContext: The 2008 S4 Avant represents the B7 generation, which featured a 4.2-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 producing 350 horsepower. Audi discontinued the manual transmission option in the S4 lineup after the 2009 model year, transitioning to dual-clutch automatics. This generation of S4 has become increasingly sought-after by collectors who value naturally-aspirated engines and traditional transmissions. The combination of low mileage, proper specification, and wagon body style makes this particular example exceptionally rare in the used market.

title: View Photos of the 2001 Sports Sedan Comparison Test
summary: See the interior and exterior of the 2001 Saab 9-3 SE, Mercedes-Benz C240, Volvo S60 T5, Lexus IS300, Audi A4 2.8 Quattro and BMW 325i from every angle.
whatHappening: Car and Driver is showcasing a comprehensive photo gallery from its 2001 sports sedan comparison test. The feature provides interior and exterior views of six competing luxury sport sedans from multiple angles.
whoInvolved: Car and Driver, a leading automotive publication, is comparing vehicles from major manufacturers: Saab, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Lexus, Audi, and BMW. These brands represent the premium and performance segments of the automotive market.
whyMatters: This comparison test helps consumers understand how top-tier sport sedans stack up against each other in design, features, and overall appeal. Visual documentation of these vehicles provides potential buyers with detailed reference material for making informed purchasing decisions in a competitive luxury market segment.
moreContext: The early 2000s marked a pivotal era for sport sedans, with manufacturers aggressively competing to attract performance-minded luxury buyers. The Lexus IS300, BMW 325i, and Audi A4 represented Japanese and German engineering prowess, while the Saab 9-3 SE, Mercedes C240, and Volvo S60 T5 showcased European alternatives. This period saw rapid advancement in sedan design, technology, and performance capabilities as automakers pushed boundaries in handling, power delivery, and interior refinement to differentiate themselves in an increasingly crowded segment.

title: Report: Chevrolet Is Already Cooking Up a Next-Generation Equinox EV
summary: The next version of the compact electric SUV is expected to arrive for the 2029 model year and will ride on a new platform.
whatHappening: Chevrolet is developing a next-generation Equinox EV that will launch for the 2029 model year. The redesigned compact electric SUV will be built on an entirely new platform.
whoInvolved: Chevrolet, General Motors' mass-market brand, is spearheading the development. GM has been aggressively expanding its EV lineup as part of its broader electrification strategy.
whyMatters: The next-gen Equinox EV signals GM's commitment to refreshing its electric vehicle portfolio with more advanced technology and capability. A new platform typically means improved range, performance, and cost efficiency, which could strengthen Chevrolet's competitive position in the growing affordable EV segment.
moreContext: The current Equinox EV launched in 2024 as one of Chevrolet's most affordable electric options, priced competitively to undercut Tesla's Model Y. GM has been investing heavily in EV development and battery technology to meet electrification targets. The 2029 timeline suggests Chevrolet will use the intervening years to refine the platform and integrate next-generation battery innovations. A redesigned platform typically enables manufacturers to reduce production costs while expanding features, which is critical as the EV market becomes increasingly price-sensitive.

title: 2027 Aston Martin Vanquish
summary: Review, Pricing, and Specs
whatHappening: Aston Martin has unveiled the 2027 Vanquish, its latest flagship grand tourer featuring a redesigned exterior, updated interior technology, and refined performance specifications. The automaker is positioning this model as a direct competitor in the high-performance luxury vehicle segment.
whoInvolved: Aston Martin, the British luxury automaker founded in 1913, continues its legacy of producing exclusive sports cars and grand tourers for ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Car and Driver, one of the automotive industry's most respected publications, is providing comprehensive coverage of the vehicle's pricing, specifications, and performance attributes.
whyMatters: The new Vanquish represents Aston Martin's effort to maintain relevance in an increasingly competitive luxury performance segment where electrification and autonomous technology are reshaping consumer expectations. This refresh is critical for the brand's financial health, as flagship models drive brand prestige and aspirational appeal across the entire lineup.
moreContext: The Vanquish nameplate has been central to Aston Martin's identity since 2001, with previous generations serving as symbols of British automotive engineering and luxury craftsmanship. The 2027 model comes as the luxury car market faces pressure from electric vehicle adoption and shifting consumer preferences toward sustainability. Aston Martin has been working to modernize its product lineup while preserving the brand heritage that appeals to its traditional customer base. This launch reflects the broader automotive industry trend of balancing heritage and performance with contemporary technology requirements.

title: View Interior Photos of the 2027 Toyota Sequoia Trailhunter
summary: The 2027 Toyota Sequoia is the latest model to get a Trailhunter package. See it from every interior angle.
whatHappening: Toyota has unveiled the 2027 Sequoia with a new Trailhunter package, offering buyers a rugged variant of the three-row SUV. Car and Driver is providing detailed interior photography showcasing the package from multiple angles.
whoInvolved: Toyota, the Japanese automaker, continues expanding its Trailhunter lineup—a sub-brand focused on off-road capability and adventure-oriented styling. Car and Driver, a leading automotive publication, is documenting the new model's interior design.
whyMatters: The Trailhunter package signals Toyota's commitment to capturing the growing market of consumers seeking adventure-ready vehicles without sacrificing three-row passenger capacity. This positioning helps Toyota compete in the premium SUV segment against rivals offering rugged variants of their flagship models.
moreContext: Toyota introduced the Trailhunter nameplate to appeal to outdoor enthusiasts and off-road adventurers, with previous models including the Sequoia Trailhunter in earlier generations. The 2027 refresh indicates the package's success and Toyota's strategy of offering lifestyle-focused variants across its SUV lineup. This trend reflects broader industry movement toward adventure-ready vehicles, as competitors like Ford (with Raptor and Tremor lines) and General Motors have similarly emphasized rugged capability. The Sequoia's three-row configuration makes it particularly attractive to families wanting both off-road credentials and practical passenger space.

title: View Exterior Photos of the 2027 Toyota Sequoia Trailhunter
summary: The 2027 Toyota Sequoia is the latest model to get a Trailhunter package. See it from every exterior angle.
whatHappening: Toyota is unveiling the 2027 Sequoia with a new Trailhunter package, showcasing the three-row SUV's rugged exterior styling from multiple angles. The Trailhunter variant represents Toyota's latest effort to inject off-road capability into its mainstream vehicle lineup.

whyMatters: The Trailhunter package positions the Sequoia to compete directly with other rugged SUV offerings in the premium large-vehicle segment where buyers increasingly prioritize off-road aesthetics and capability. This move signals Toyota's commitment to capturing the lucrative adventure and lifestyle market that has driven strong sales for competitor models like the Ford Expedition and Chevrolet Tahoe variants.
moreContext: Toyota introduced the Trailhunter nameplate across multiple models in recent years, with successful implementations on vehicles like the 4Runner and Tundra. The Sequoia, Toyota's three-row full-size SUV competitor, competes in a segment where rugged styling packages have become increasingly popular with consumers seeking adventure-ready vehicles. The 2027 model year refresh represents a significant update cycle for the Sequoia platform. This expansion of the Trailhunter brand demonstrates Toyota's strategy to appeal to outdoor enthusiasts and lifestyle-oriented buyers across its entire lineup.

title: Toyota Updates the Oddball Crown for 2027 with New Hybrid Setup
summary: Toyota says the Crown XLE, Limited, and Nightshade get an updated hybrid system, but it's being coy about the details of this revised setup.
whatHappening: Toyota is refreshing its 2027 Crown lineup with an updated hybrid system across the XLE, Limited, and Nightshade trim levels. The automaker has remained tight-lipped about the specific details of this revised powertrain setup.
whoInvolved: Toyota, the Japanese automotive giant known for pioneering hybrid technology, is making these changes to its Crown sedan, a model that has regained U.S. market relevance after a decades-long absence.
whyMatters: The hybrid update signals Toyota's continued commitment to electrification amid tightening emissions regulations and consumer demand for fuel efficiency. Better hybrid efficiency could improve the Crown's competitive positioning in the sedan market, where hybrid powertrains are becoming increasingly standard.
moreContext: The Crown nameplate made its triumphant return to North America in 2023 after nearly two decades away, targeting luxury sedan buyers seeking an alternative to traditional German competitors. Toyota's hybrid expertise has established it as an industry leader in electrification, with the technology now spanning multiple segments beyond its iconic Prius. The company's reluctance to reveal specifics about the hybrid updates suggests potential performance or efficiency gains that may be unveiled closer to the 2027 model year launch. This refresh demonstrates how even established model lines require continuous powertrain evolution to meet market demands and regulatory requirements.

title: Honda Civic Si and Manual Integra Production to Pause After 2026
summary: Honda will put the Civic Si and manual-equipped Acura Integra A-Spec on hold after the 2026 model year, but it promises they will return.
whatHappening: Honda is halting production of the Civic Si and manual-transmission Acura Integra A-Spec after the 2026 model year. The company says both models will make a comeback, though no timeline has been announced.
whoInvolved: Honda Motor Company and its luxury division Acura are making this decision. Both brands have built loyal followings around these performance-oriented, manual-transmission vehicles that appeal to driving enthusiasts.
whyMatters: Manual transmissions and performance variants like the Si are increasingly rare as automakers shift to automatics and electrification. This move reflects broader industry headwinds for gas-powered enthusiast cars, though Honda's commitment to bringing them back suggests the market for these vehicles hasn't disappeared entirely.
moreContext: The Civic Si has been a entry-level performance staple since 1984, known for offering manual transmission and tuning potential at an accessible price point. The Acura Integra, which returned in 2023 after a 17-year hiatus, marked Honda's effort to revive the enthusiast nameplate and included a manual A-Spec variant. Rising emissions regulations and consumer preference shifts toward SUVs and electric vehicles have pressured automakers to discontinue niche manual models. Honda's decision to pause rather than cancel entirely signals confidence in eventual demand recovery, possibly tied to future powertrains or market conditions.

title: Mercedes-Benz Faces Potential Ban in the U.S. Due to Senate Moves
summary: While an outright ban seems unlikely, newly approved legislation could put the German automaker in jeopardy.
whatHappening: The U.S. Senate has approved legislation that could potentially jeopardize Mercedes-Benz's operations in America. While a complete ban remains unlikely, the newly passed measures create significant regulatory hurdles for the German automaker.
whoInvolved: Mercedes-Benz, the luxury German automaker, is the primary company facing potential restrictions. The U.S. Senate, led by lawmakers concerned about foreign automotive competition and supply chain issues, has taken legislative action.
whyMatters: If enacted, the legislation could disrupt Mercedes-Benz's substantial U.S. market presence and profitability, affecting its sales and manufacturing operations. The move also signals a broader shift toward protectionist automotive policies that could reshape how foreign automakers operate in America.
moreContext: The Senate action reflects growing concerns about foreign automotive dominance in the U.S. market and potential national security issues related to vehicle technology and supply chains. Mercedes-Benz has maintained a significant American presence through imports and some domestic manufacturing. Recent years have seen increased congressional scrutiny of foreign automakers, particularly regarding electric vehicle production and semiconductor sourcing. The legislation appears designed to strengthen American automotive competitiveness rather than completely eliminate foreign competitors.

title: 2027 Nissan Z NISMO with New Six-Speed Manual Starts Under $69K
summary: All prices rise by $1460, but you'll pay the same for a new 2027 Nissan Z whether or not you choose the DIY gearbox.
whatHappening: Nissan is pricing the 2027 Z NISMO with a new six-speed manual transmission starting under $69,000. All 2027 Z models are seeing price increases of $1,460, but the manual and automatic variants are priced identically.
whoInvolved: Nissan, the Japanese automaker, is reviving the manual transmission option for its Z sports car line. Car and Driver is reporting on the pricing and availability of this performance variant.
whyMatters: The move signals Nissan's commitment to offering driver engagement options in an era when manual transmissions are disappearing from the market. This decision directly appeals to enthusiasts who value traditional driving experiences, potentially influencing buyer decisions in the affordable sports car segment.
moreContext: The Z nameplate has a storied history dating back to 1969, and Nissan reintroduced the modern Z in 2023 after a years-long hiatus. The NISMO variant represents the brand's high-performance sub-label. The pricing strategy of charging the same for both manual and automatic transmissions is unusual in today's market, where manuals typically command premium pricing or are offered at a discount depending on demand and production costs.

title: The 800-HP Rezvani Dune Is an Even Wilder Lamborghini Sterrato
summary: Rezvani took a Huracán and gave it more power, more clearance, and more completely insane bodywork.
whatHappening: Rezvani has unveiled the Dune, an extreme off-road variant of the Lamborghini Huracán that cranks power up to 800 horsepower and adds aggressive styling with increased ground clearance. The customization shop has transformed a supercar designed for pavement into a wild, high-performance desert machine.
whoInvolved: Rezvani is a Los Angeles-based custom car manufacturer known for creating heavily modified versions of exotic vehicles, particularly Lamborghinis. The company specializes in reimagining performance cars with bespoke engineering and dramatic aesthetic upgrades.
whyMatters: This vehicle exemplifies the growing trend of ultra-wealthy buyers seeking one-of-a-kind, unconventional supercars that blur the line between road and off-road capability. It demonstrates how custom shops are pushing boundaries on what's possible when modifying already-extreme machines, potentially influencing future factory offerings in the adventure supercar category.
moreContext: Lamborghini itself entered the off-road supercar space with the Sterrato in 2023, a lifted Huracán variant that garnered significant media attention. Rezvani's Dune builds on this trend but takes it further with more extensive modifications and significantly higher horsepower figures. Custom Lamborghini builders have become increasingly popular among collectors seeking differentiation from standard models. This movement reflects broader automotive interest in combining luxury performance with rugged capability, a niche that traditional manufacturers are only beginning to explore.

title: 2027 Audi SQ7
summary: What We Know So Far
whatHappening: Audi is preparing to launch the 2027 SQ7, the high-performance variant of its popular Q7 luxury SUV. The automaker is releasing preliminary details about what consumers can expect from the next generation.

whyMatters: The SQ7 refresh signals Audi's commitment to evolving its performance SUV lineup as luxury buyers increasingly demand both power and advanced technology. Audi has been rolling out incremental updates to its Q-series SUVs while simultaneously developing electric alternatives under its e-tron sub-brand. The timing of the 2027 SQ7 refresh reflects broader industry trends of extending traditional performance vehicles while transitioning toward electrified powertrains.

title: 2028 Land Rover Range Rover GT
